subject: Startups
title: Starbucks: Beans to Beverages
description: A quick, practical guide to Starbucks: Beans to Beverages.

hook.text: The original Starbucks sold only whole coffee beans and equipment. They didn't serve a single cup of coffee.

buildup.text: Howard Schultz joined in 1982 and visited Italy, where he saw espresso bars on every corner. He was captivated.

discovery.text: Schultz wanted Starbucks to serve drinks. The founders refused. He quit to open his own café chain instead.

twist.text: Schultz's cafés thrived. He bought Starbucks in 1987 for $3.8 million and pivoted the brand to serving beverages.

climax.text: That market pivot—from selling beans to selling the experience—turned Starbucks into a $100 billion company.

punchline.text: They sold beans. He sold the experience. He won.

quiz.question: What inspired Howard Schultz to pivot Starbucks to serving drinks?
